item.title: modsweep 1.4.0
item.description:
modsweep 1.4.0 — automatic updates

  • Updates install themselves: modsweep checks for a new version once a day, downloads it from GitHub Releases, checks its signatures and replaces itself, so you no longer download DMGs by hand
  • modsweep → Check for Updates… looks right away; Settings let you turn the daily check and automatic installs on or off
  • An update never restarts the app while a clean, verify or share is running; it waits until the work is done
